title: THOSE RYDERZ
summary: THOSE RYDERZ is JAB Visions' flagship cinematic IP: a coming-of-age supernatural superhero drama about five young people transformed by living auras released through the seven bowls of Armageddon.
facts: The public premise is: seven sins, five signals, and one awakening. The first Ryderz are marked by power, burdened by personal flaws, and tied to the language of the seven deadly sins.
Rubi Wong, the Red Ryder, is associated with envy and has duplication, empathic awareness, and a red light blade.
Leo Montana, the Yellow Ryder, is associated with pride and has super speed, kinetic impact, and spiked knuckles.
Aaron Addams, the Black Ryder, is associated with greed and has teleportation, shadow movement, and a black aura axe.
Zoe Folie, the Blue Ryder, is associated with lust and has force fields, levitation, and blue energy projection.
Keven Hart, the Pink Ryder, is associated with sloth and has invisibility, phasing, phantom movement, and pink energy darts.
Public themes include faith, identity, desire, flaw, transformation, destruction, resistance, and becoming an answer to prayer without escaping human weakness.

The public project status is a feature film in development, with a pitch deck in development and existing proof-of-concept material. The site calls it a first transmission into a larger mythology; no release date or further production commitment is confirmed.
